facts.subject: Customers in China
facts.evidence: Customers in China represented 29.1% of our 2025 total net sales and 36.1% of our 2024 net sales.

facts.subject: customers in Taiwan
facts.evidence: customers in Taiwan – who represented 25.5% of our 2025 total net sales and 15.4% of our 2024 total net sales.

facts.subject: Customers in South Korea
facts.evidence: Customers in South Korea represented 25.0% of our 2025 total net sales and 22.7% of our 2024 total net sales.

facts.subject: our largest customer
facts.evidence: Total net sales to our largest customer amounted to €7,796.7 million , or 23.9% of total net sales in 2025 , compared with €4,682.4 million , or 16.6% of total net sales in 2024 .

facts.subject: our two largest customers
facts.evidence: In 2025 , 38.0% of total net sales were made to our two largest customers.

facts.subject: components and subassemblies used in our systems
facts.evidence: We depend on third-party vendors for the components and subassemblies used in our systems, including their design. Many of these parts are single-sourced or supplied by a limited number of vendors.

facts.subject: four cu stomers
facts.evidence: In 2025 , four cu stomers each individually exceeded 10% of total net sales , totaling € 20.0 billion , or 61.2 % , of total net sales.

facts.subject: Our three largest customers (based on total net sales)
facts.evidence: Our three largest customers (based on total net sales) accounted for € 1.3 billion , or 35.4 % , of accounts receivable and finance receivables at December 31, 2025
